changelog: Reminders: with Reminders on, the form has an unticked "Remind me once if it's still in stock and I haven't ordered it." box, recorded with its words and time. The hourly sweep sends one "Still in stock" email (crestock_reminder) a set number of hours after the alert (24 by default, 1 to 168) to shoppers who ticked it, while the item is still in stock and they haven't bought it. Claimed in one conditional UPDATE, so it goes once.

My Account: a "Back in stock" tab (back-in-stock) listing the open requests the account made while signed in, with state, place in line, expected date and Remove. Guest requests under the account's address aren't listed, since WooCommerce lets an account take any address without proving it.

Demand shown to shoppers: "N people are waiting for …" on the form, in the page's language, with the count from a public, cached GET /creative-restock/v1/items/{id}/waiting read by assets/waiting.js; and "You're number N in line" in the reply, after the confirm link and in My Account, while the order in line is oldest first.

Discontinued items: a box on each product and variation, and an alternative chosen with WooCommerce's product search. Ten minutes after saving, the item's open requests end and each waiting shopper gets one "No longer available" email (crestock_discontinued), with "Notify me about … instead" when there's an alternative, which moves the request to it once (replace). The form says "No longer available" and takes no asks.

Priority: who hears first by when they asked (the default), lifetime spend (accounts and guests' paid orders, less refunds) or customer role (a number per role; blank roles after, guests last). Ties stay oldest first.
Hide the form on chosen products (a box on the product), categories or tags. Asks for them are refused.

A popup style: a button opens the form in a native <dialog> (assets/popup.js), with its title, focus kept inside and returned to the button, Escape to close, and the form left on the page without JavaScript.
Button colour, text colour, corners and class. A colour pair under 4.5:1 contrast isn't saved, and the error gives the ratio.
With WooCommerce's "Hide out of stock items" on, variable products get a "Notify me when a sold-out option is back" chooser, since the sold-out options can't be picked.
A unit test that fails when assets/form.js passes 5 KB.

Deleting requests asks first: a confirmation screen lists the requests by address and item (50 at most, then "and N more"), with "Delete N requests" and Cancel, works without JavaScript and returns to the list page with its filters (WCAG 3.3.4).
The suggested privacy text uses the shop's own expiry and deletion settings, not 12 months and 90 days.
